تستفسرون (form X)
# تَسْتَفْسِرُونَ (tastafsirūna) /tas.taf.si.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَفْسَرَ (istafsara)
# تُسْتَفْسَرُونَ (tustafsarūna) /tus.taf.sa.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَفْسَرَ (istafsara)
